info.about: ALCOR is an anime and manga discovery website with a private media library. It does not host videos or manga chapters.
info.help: Browse titles without an account. Sign in to save anime and manga, track your progress and organize your library. Scores and release details are credited to their sources.
info.sources: Anime and manga information comes from AniList. Episode titles, descriptions and images come through AniZip. Some details may be missing. Each title links to its source. Your library, notes and progress are kept separately from public title information.
info.privacy: Your library, notes and progress are private. A full privacy notice and account deletion controls are not available yet.
info.terms: ALCOR is a personal project. Terms of service are not available yet.
info.status: Browse anime and manga freely. If saving or tracking is temporarily unavailable, you can keep browsing and try again later.

setup.intro: Three steps. Nine optional questions. Start with what you know, skip anything, and change it later.

setup.lengthQuestion: 9. How many episodes would you like to commit to?
